name: Target-independent internal conservative dynamics with a proved FIN reduction
why_selected: A source-to-reduction construction can connect a kinetic law to antecedent evolution; a target-built dilation only establishes compatibility.
not_claimed: This is not a theorem that all possible physical FIN completions must be Hamiltonian or have a globally defined conserved energy.

required_object.carrier: An explicitly sourced internal phase/interaction carrier Omega of the nadsoliton; no ontologically lower information layer.
required_object.evolution: A well-posed autonomous evolution Phi_t, with its generator, domains and reversal; if Hamiltonian, give E and a Poisson operator satisfying Jacobi.
required_object.coupling: Actual internal coupling and preparation law derived without fitting the FIN target rates or a desired bath spectrum.
required_object.projection: R: Omega -> {0,...,11}^N when labelled FIN histories are claimed; specify conditional preparation Lambda_x on each fibre.
required_object.output: A new target-independent restriction on a kinetic rate ratio, or full labelled trajectory law with a stated horizon/error and fixed clock convention.
required_object.law_requirement: For licensed initial laws and cylinders, compare the autonomous R(Phi_t omega) process without intermediate hidden resets to the declared FIN labelled process. A scalar covariance match or projected drift is insufficient.

minimal_new_atom: A sourced nonzero reversible current/carrier with its coupling, or another independently derived kinetic restriction; it is absent from the present unchanged occupation action.
countermodels_to_retain: Native HB/MET/BAR kinetic alternatives with their declared common clock conventions
Explicit labelled reset lifts with arbitrary hidden eta
Supplied AUX-HB-OU feedback comparator, stationary reflected preparation only
Different symmetric activities at the same equilibrium and declared total energy
intrinsic_dependency_delta: Tests that a proposed source must pass are sharpened; no natural kinetic, composition or operational source is supplied.
new_model_policy: Any independently proposed microscopic law remains a separate proposal requiring architectural authorization and its own model ID before adoption. This report makes no adoption request.
